lead.tldr: Spot Bitcoin ETFs record $962 million inflows led by BlackRock signaling institutional re-entry. • Crypto funds attract $1 billion ending five-week outflow streak on Bitcoin rebound. • Bank of Japan launches blockchain sandbox for reserve settlement testing central bank adoption. • Uniswap wins court ruling on scam token liability boosting DeFi developer protections. • US Senate bill bans Fed CBDC until 2030 with stablecoin exception easing regulatory fears. • Nasdaq files for prediction market contracts expanding crypto-adjacent Wall Street tools.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, Spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $458 million inflows amid surging volumes and a $1 billion crypto fund rebound. Bank of Japan tests blockchain for reserves while Uniswap's legal win bolsters DeFi protections.

top_signals.title: Spot bitcoin ETFs post $458 million in net inflows as institutions buy into global instability: analysts
top_signals.summary: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $458 million in net inflows on Monday, led by BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) with $263 million, signaling robust institutional accumulation amid recent weeks of outflows. This surge contrasts with retail investor exits from platforms like Binance, highlighting institutions' dominance as they position Bitcoin as a hedge against escalating Middle East conflicts and global geopolitical tensions. For institutional investors, the inflows underscore Bitcoin's maturation as a portfolio diversifier, with cumulative ETF assets exceeding $55 billion and BlackRock's IBIT alone surpassing $50 billion, enhancing liquidity and long-term exposure options. Analysts note this shift boosts price resilience near $68,000, with $60,000 as key support amid ongoing market volatility.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin ETFs Surge as Trading Volumes Reach February Highs
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin ETFs experienced a surge in trading volumes, reaching the highest levels since early February. Spot Bitcoin funds recorded $458 million in inflows, indicating strong investor interest.

top_signals.title: Bank of Japan to test blockchain-based reserve settlement: Governor Ueda
top_signals.summary: Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda announced a sandbox environment to test the feasibility of central bank money operating on blockchain-based systems. This initiative explores the potential of blockchain technology for reserve settlement.

top_signals.title: Former LAPD officer found guilty of kidnapping teen in crypto robbery: report
top_signals.summary: Former LAPD officer Eric Halem was found guilty of kidnapping and robbery for stealing $350,000 in bitcoin. The incident occurred in 2024.

top_signals.title: Boards aren’t ready for the AI age: What happens when your CEO gets deepfaked?
top_signals.summary: The article discusses the increasing threat of deepfake attacks targeting CEOs and the lack of preparedness among companies to handle such situations. It highlights the vulnerability of CEO likenesses and the potential for boardroom emergencies due to deepfakes.

top_signals.title: BOJ Tests Blockchain for Bank Reserve Settlement
top_signals.summary: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) is testing blockchain technology for bank reserve settlement in a sandbox environment. The central bank is examining settlement using current account deposits and also warning of smart contract design risks.

top_signals.title: ‘Scammers are liable’: Uniswap CEO reacts to landmark court dismissal
top_signals.summary: Uniswap CEO reacts to a landmark court dismissal, suggesting scammers are liable. This legal win could set the stage for broader DeFi developer protections.

top_signals.title: Crypto funds attract $1 billion, ending five-week outflow streak as investors seek entry points amid bitcoin-led rebound: CoinShares
top_signals.summary: Crypto funds experienced a reversal with $1 billion in inflows, ending a five-week outflow streak. This shift is attributed to a bitcoin-led recovery, according to CoinShares.

top_signals.title: Crypto ETPs Post $1B Inflows as Bitcoin Leads Gains
top_signals.summary: Crypto ETPs experienced a significant turnaround, recording $1 billion in inflows after a five-week period of $4 billion in outflows, according to CoinShares. This indicates renewed investor interest in crypto assets, particularly Bitcoin.

top_signals.title: Judge Hands Win to Uniswap in Class Action Over Scams
top_signals.summary: A judge ruled in favor of Uniswap in a class action lawsuit, stating that the platform is not liable for scam tokens traded on it. The court determined Uniswap is not responsible for the actions of third parties using the platform.

top_signals.title: Nasdaq Joins Wall Street Push For Prediction Markets
top_signals.summary: Nasdaq has filed with the SEC to offer cash-settled, binary-style contracts on the Nasdaq-100. This will allow traders to make prediction market-style bets on the index.

top_signals.title: US Senate Bill Seeks to Ban the Fed From Issuing a CBDC
top_signals.summary: A US Senate bill aims to prohibit the Federal Reserve from issuing a central bank digital currency (CBDC) until 2030. The bill includes an exception for permissionless, privacy-preserving stablecoins.
